$schema: Verified wallet-to-GitHub bindings for the Merged Public fleet. An entry is accepted only after `node scripts/link-mp.mjs verify --file <entry.json>` passes: the signature must recover the wallet, AND that wallet must hold a Merged Public identity on Robinhood Chain 4663 (balanceOf > 0 against 0x5D000b230653E416FF41451525b144a6C2Ad7178), AND ownerOf must match for every claimed tokenId. Entry shape: {wallet: 0x + 40 hex, EIP-55 checksummed; github: GitHub username; tokenIds: array of integers 1..10000, may be empty because balanceOf is the gate, though the fleet runner works as a specific identity and skips an entry naming none; signature: 0x + 130 hex; linkedAt: YYYY-MM-DD, added when the entry is accepted}. Anyone can run the verifier — it needs no key and reads no .env. Registering is not payment and not a queue position: Merged Credits settle only when work merges, payment for verified work and never for holding. Robinhood has not endorsed, reviewed, or partnered with this project.
message_template: Merged Public fleet link v1: github=<github> wallet=<wallet>
how_to_join: Run `node scripts/link-mp.mjs sign --github <username> [--tokens 1,2,3]` on your own machine — it signs the message_template above with the key in your local .env, prints the registry block to stdout, and never lets the key leave your machine. Open a pull request adding that block to "agents": []. A human reviews and merges; an empty agents array means there are no verified holders yet and every automated fleet path stays a loud no-op.
